title: U.S. June CPI Fell 0.4% MoM; Headline YoY 3.5%, Core 2.6%—Below All Forecasts
summary: The BLS reported June CPI -0.4% MoM, putting the YoY rate at 3.5% (vs. forecast 3.8%, May's 4.2%). Core CPI was flat on the month, with 12-month core at 2.6%. The S&P 500 rose 0.38% and the Nasdaq gained 0.9% on the print, led by semiconductor stocks.
why: 通胀大幅低于预期，CPI六月份大跌0.4%，核心通胀12个月仅2.6%——主因油价回落；但美联储7月会议仍预期按兵不动（FedWatch 85.6%持稳）。纳指反弹利好科技持仓，短期Sell Put窗口略微改善，但需警惕油价反弹重推通胀。

title: IBM Shares Plunge 25%—Worst Day on Record—After Q2 Revenue Miss; Enterprise Software Stocks Rattled
summary: IBM pre-announced Q2 2026 revenue of $17.2B (vs. $17.86B estimate), with infrastructure revenue -7% as clients shifted capex to servers, storage, and memory ahead of supply-constrained price rises. The 25% single-day decline exceeded IBM's previous record crash on Black Monday 1987.
why: IBM暴跌25%是本周最重要宏观信号：大企业将季末预算转向AI基础设施抢货（存储/服务器/内存），软件预算被挤压。对持仓的含义：利好SK海力士、美光、英伟达等存储/AI芯片；软件类ETF与相关持仓须关注连锁影响，同时也显示AI硬件需求极度旺盛。

title: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses; Brent Crude Surges to ~$85, WTI at $79.56—Risk-Off Hits Asia
summary: President Trump reversed his offer to lift a 20% Strait of Hormuz protection fee, reigniting US-Iran tensions. Brent crude rose ~2% to $84.95/barrel and WTI gained 1.82% to $79.56. The renewed conflict, which first erupted on Feb. 28 with US-Israeli airstrikes, weighed heavily on Hong Kong equities (HSI -1%) and inflation expectations.
why: 地缘风险重燃是本轮港股回调主因（恒指跌1%），同时推升油价进一步加大CPI回落的不确定性；高油价对能源敏感型消费股（餐饮/出行）形成成本压力，对持有科技消费股的策略需关注宏观通胀路径变化。

title: Hang Seng Index Falls Over 1% to ~23,970 as Iran Tensions and Weak US Futures Dampen Sentiment
summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dropped more than 1% (approximately 240 points) to around 23,970 on July 15, as renewed US-Iran hostilities and sliding Wall Street futures weighed on risk appetite. Investors were also cautious ahead of China's Q2 GDP data due July 16.
why: 港股大盘跌逾1%，恒指年内仍在两万三左右震荡；卖出期权（Sell Put）持仓须注意隐含波动率是否上升以及行权价安全边际，同时留意7月16日中国Q2 GDP数据对市场情绪的提振或拖累。

title: 6月中国出口同比+27%创历史新高至4124亿美元，贸易顺差1256亿美元史上第二高
summary: 中国6月出口同比增长27%至4124亿美元，大幅超市场预期的18.2%，刷新历史最高纪录；进口同比+36%；贸易顺差1256亿美元创史上第二高。AI相关硬件（半导体为最大单项，占出口约10%）是最主要驱动力，同时出口商赶在关税进一步落地前抢出货。
why: 出口爆增提振A股情绪（沪指+1.36%，深成+2.77%），AI硬件出口激增间接验证国内AI产业链景气；同时强出口支撑Q2 GDP预期（明日公布），对科技/消费持仓整体利好。

title: A股强势反弹：沪指涨1.36%报3967点，深成涨2.77%，科技板块领涨
summary: 受6月出口数据超预期提振，A股7月15日大幅反弹，上证综指涨1.36%收报3967.1点（此前曾触三个月低位），深证成指涨2.77%至14924.9点。科技股（光模块、半导体设备）、铝、钼、黄金矿等板块领涨。
why: A股从前日低点显著反弹，出口数据超预期为核心催化；科技/金属主题个股走强；明日Q2 GDP数据（预期4.6-4.9%）是下一个重要验证节点，若低于预期可能再度引发情绪回落。

title: Fed Funds Rate Steady at 3.50–3.75%; July 28-29 FOMC Expected to Hold Despite Below-Forecast CPI
summary: The Fed funds rate remains at 3.50–3.75% after June's softer-than-expected CPI. CME FedWatch shows 85.6% probability of no change at the July 28-29 meeting, up from 58.3% before the print. However, markets price ~42% chance of at least one 25bp hike by year-end given renewed oil pressures.
why: 7月按兵不动概率大，但年内仍有42%概率加息——这一路径主要取决于油价走势。对Sell Put策略：高利率+高IV环境中期权premium维持高位，是相对有利条件；但需警惕年末加息导致指数二次回调。

title: Tencent Slashes Kuaishou Stake for ~HK$12.5B, Co-Leads Kling AI's $3B Round at $18B Valuation
summary: Tencent sold 272.9M Kuaishou Class B shares at HK$43.25 each (~HK$12.5B total), reducing its stake from 15.68% to 9.37% and exiting as a substantial shareholder. Simultaneously, Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu jointly backed Kling AI (可灵AI) in its first standalone funding round at an $18B post-money valuation—a global record for a video generative AI company.
why: 腾讯'换仓'信号明确：出清快手Beta敞口，换入Kling AI（视频大模型）的Alpha。BAT三家罕见联合背书同一AI项目，Kling AI $180亿美元估值创视频AI全球纪录；对腾讯持仓——减持回笼HK$125亿现金，同时AI战略布局更聚焦，长期利好，短期因减持消息导致快手承压（跌12%）。

title: Alibaba Settles $600M DOJ Non-Prosecution Deal Over Illegal Drug Sales; BABA Jumped ~12%
summary: Alibaba and its U.S. payment arm AUS Merchant Services agreed to a $600M non-prosecution settlement with the DOJ over allegations of facilitating ~80,000 illegal pharmaceutical sales (2016–2024). The stock surged ~12% on July 2 as the settlement cleared a major legal overhang. Analysts at Daiwa and Nomura trimmed price targets but maintained Buy ratings.
why: 最大法律风险出清，BABA估值重估空间打开；同时通义千问Qwen活跃用户持续增长，阿里云AI营收提速，与Eli Lilly合作进入GLP-1医疗场景。Sell Put行权价下行风险已大幅收窄，关注后续季报（8月前后）进一步验证云业务反转。

title: Pop Mart Opens 'THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary' World Tour in NYC (July 17); First U.S. Exhibition Stop
summary: Pop Mart's 'THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary World Tour' exhibition opens July 17 in New York City—the first U.S. stop—following successful runs in Shanghai, Taipei, Hong Kong, Paris, and Tokyo. The show runs through August 31 and marks Labubu's largest U.S. branding moment to date.
why: Labubu登陆纽约是出海里程碑事件，直接提升北美消费者对9992.HK核心IP的认知度。与段永平加仓（持仓至7.65%）共振——但需留意Hair Salon系列在国内市场溢价走弱（6月新品在二级市场低于建议零售价），提示IP热度边际有松动。

title: Billionaire Duan Yongping Raises Pop Mart Stake to 7.65% Amid Signs of Labubu Demand Softening
summary: Chinese billionaire Duan Yongping ('China's Warren Buffett') increased his stake in Pop Mart (9992.HK) from 6.85% to 7.65% (102M shares total) via H&H International Investment on July 6. The move came even as the new Labubu Hair Salon series launched with multiple variants trading at or below official retail prices—an unusual sign for the typically premium-trading IP.
why: 段永平加仓是重要信号，但同时Hair Salon系列溢价走弱值得高度关注：新IP未复制此前Labubu稀缺效应，意味着后续估值支撑更多来自大股东护盘而非IP动能。对9992.HK Sell Put策略：行权价选择需更保守，建议留出额外下行缓冲。

title: Xiaomi Unveils 'Sky Nomad' (天蓬) EREV SUV Series; Expands Auto Lineup Beyond SU7 and YU7
summary: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun announced a new EREV (Extended-Range Electric Vehicle) SUV series called 'Sky Nomad' (Xiaomi Pengcheng/天蓬) on July 9, 2026. The series targets a broader demographic than the SU7 sedan and YU7 crossover. Through end-June, Xiaomi had delivered 258,232 YU7 units since June 2025 launch.
why: 小米汽车从单品类（SU7轿车+YU7 SUV）扩展至EREV增程版，产品矩阵逐步完善，覆盖更广续航需求；YU7累计25.8万辆交付验证产品力。1810.HK长线逻辑（手机+汽车+AIoT生态）持续强化，雷军汽车业务兑现超预期。

title: Tesla Miami Robotaxi Live as of July 3; First User Impressions Documented July 14 Ahead of Q2 Earnings
summary: Tesla's driverless Robotaxi service launched in Miami (10–14 sq. miles in western Miami-Dade) on July 3, 2026—making Miami the second city after Texas. FSD v14 Lite began rolling out to HW3 vehicles. Q2 2026 deliveries were ~480,000 vehicles and 13.5 GWh of energy storage. Full Q2 earnings call is July 22.
why: Robotaxi扩至迈阿密兑现商业化叙事，Q2交付、储能均创纪录；7月22日财报是近期重要期权窗口——可考虑在财报前后管理Sell Put或Covered Call头寸以应对可能的大波动。若财报超预期，隐含波动率在事件后通常回落，出售高位IV的Put有较好胜率。

title: SK Hynix Lists on Nasdaq as SKHY; $26.5B IPO Largest-Ever Foreign U.S. Debut, Surges 13% on Day One
summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5 billion in the U.S.'s largest-ever foreign company IPO (surpassing Alibaba's 2014 $25B), pricing at $149/ADS and closing first-day trading at $168.01 (+13%). Permanent ticker SKHY began on July 13. The company also shipped HBM4E samples to major customers on June 18, with 2026 HBM supply fully sold out.
why: SK海力士美股上市是HBM产业链最大融资事件，标志HBM赛道进入华尔街主流。对持有南方两倍做多SK海力士（CSOP SKHY ETF）的投资者：美股ADS与港股7709.HK同步上市增加流动性；HBM4E样品发货+全年产能售罄共同验证AI存储超级周期。需注意两倍ETF的每日再平衡损耗。

title: Circle Receives OCC National Trust Bank Charter to Self-Custody USDC Reserves; CRCL Surges 14%
summary: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) approved Circle's application to operate as a national trust bank (Circle National Trust), enabling it to directly hold the cash and Treasury assets backing USDC (~$74B in circulation). CRCL shares surged ~14% on the announcement July 10. Mizuho noted the charter doesn't resolve core USDC growth and competition concerns.
why: OCC批准是USDC合规体系的重大里程碑，恰在GENIUS Act合规截止日（7月18日）前完成——降低了第三方银行风险，提高储备透明度。但USDC流通量从3月高点缩水约70亿美元，新稳定币竞争（Open USD等）仍是中期隐患；GENIUS Act 7月18日到期前后需关注监管细则落地细节。

title: GENIUS Act Stablecoin Compliance Deadline Falls July 18; Circle Faces Key Test on CRCL Volatility Risk
summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year transition period (signed July 18, 2025) expires July 18, 2026, requiring stablecoin issuers to comply with new federal reserve management, licensing, and supervision standards. Analysts flag elevated CRCL stock volatility risk around the deadline as market assesses Circle's compliance posture and competitive position.
why: 7月18日是本周最重要的监管节点：GENIUS Act全面生效将定义USDC合规框架。若过渡顺利，为CRCL提供长期确定性支撑；若细则加重发行方负担（如与银行联合发行限制），可能压制估值。Sell Put策略在此前后需控制仓位或选择行权价更低的安全垫。

title: Palantir Wins U.S. Army NGC2 Data Layer Contract; Nvidia Air-Gapped AI Partnership Drives PLTR Rally ~14%
summary: The U.S. Army selected Palantir Foundry as the cloud data layer for its highest-priority NGC2 modernization program, moving from prototype to broad deployment. A separate initiative with Nvidia will run classified AI models on air-gapped government hardware. D.A. Davidson upgraded PLTR to Buy with a $175 target. PLTR had fallen ~37% from recent highs before the catalysts.
why: Palantir国防AI双催化：Army NGC2背书Foundry平台的不可替代性，Nvidia合作为机密环境AI落地提供技术背书；两项合同均为长期、高壁垒收入来源。高估值（下调前PLTR曾跌37%）意味着已在价格中定价部分乐观预期，Sell Put建议保守行权价。

title: PDD/Temu Q1 Double-Miss, €200M EU Fine, and China Regulatory Probe; Stock Down ~34% YTD
summary: PDD reported Q1 2026 revenue of $15.4B vs. $2.40 EPS estimate (significant double miss). A €200M EU fine on Temu was levied in May; Chinese regulators summoned PDD over alleged false advertising on June 11; Irish and Chinese authorities raided PDD and Temu facilities. U.S. de minimis termination further erodes Temu's pricing edge. Stock is down ~34% year-to-date.
why: 拼多多三重负面叠加（业绩、监管、关税），估值重估压力持续；Temu在欧洲被罚€2亿+出口合规成本上升+国内监管趋严，短期内基本面改善路径不清晰。若持有PDD相关Sell Put，需重新评估行权价是否仍有足够安全边际，建议选用更深度虚值。

title: Micron Issues Record FY2026 Q3 Guidance: ~$33.5B Revenue, 81% Gross Margin; HBM Sold Out Through 2026
summary: Micron (MU) guided fiscal Q3 FY2026 revenue of approximately $33.5B with 81% gross margin and >$19 EPS, well above prior estimates. All HBM supply is fully allocated through 2026, with structural constraints expected to persist into 2027. The company has crossed the $1T market cap milestone.
why: 美光HBM全年售罄+创纪录毛利验证AI存储超级周期；IBM事件（客户季末抢购内存/存储）是同一逻辑的直接体现。对做多美光（MU）及两倍做多产品头寸：中线逻辑强化，持仓方向明确，但$1T市值后估值扩张空间已部分定价，Sell Put行权价可对应当前强劲基本面上调保护位。

title: Intel Foundry Enters 18A-P Risk Production; INTC's 460% Rally Hinges on Yield Ramp in H2 2026
summary: Intel Foundry advanced its 18A-P process to risk production on June 16, offering up to 9% higher performance or 18% lower power vs. standard 18A. Microsoft and AWS have placed custom chip orders. However, analysts warn profitable yields may slip to late 2026 or 2027, creating significant execution risk for the stock's recent rally.
why: 英特尔18A-P进入风险生产是半导体制造里程碑，但'风险生产'≠良率量产——若良率爬坡慢于预期，INTC的大幅反弹（据报道+460%）面临兑现压力。对英特尔持仓：近期高歌猛进后建议设置止盈/Covered Call，以防良率不达标引发回调。
